description: Zcash coinbase attribution over the last 10-500 blocks: the shielded-pool share of block rewards (privacy mining), coinbase outputs split into consensus funding streams (lockbox) vs real miner payout addresses, and the pool tags miners printed into their own coinbase text plus our own /RobotBase/ tag. When to use: privacy-pool mining trends, shielded adoption, or checking whether our own pool found blocks. Scope: chain facts only — no third-party pool label list is applied.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to classify (default 200)
